svg.text: 03 / LitterBuggy V2 — acquisition and evidence flow
Implemented draft behavior is identified as SOURCE ONLY | running sketch, installed devices and Pi deployment remain unverified
CONFIRMED = stated scope only | CONFLICTING = evidence disagrees | PROPOSED = intent | UNKNOWN = insufficient evidence
PIPELINE / SOLID GREEN = CODE BEHAVIOR; DASHED = PROPOSED OR UNVERIFIED PHYSICAL INTERFACE
CROSS-CUTTING SOURCE BEHAVIOR / APPLIES TO THE PIPELINE ABOVE; NOT AN OPERATING ACCEPTANCE RECORD
DEPLOYMENT REVIEW / THE NEW CONTRACT DOES NOT PROVE THE RUNNING BUILD
MPU-6050: raw axes + internal die temp.
S06 reports HC-SR04 lost; fit unknown.
A02YYUW UART has no driver here.
v, type, fw, seq, ms, imu_raw,
All drivers / feedback OFF by default.
Pi input / serial or labeled replay
Physical USB port must be configured.
Serial reads feed the same recorder.
Replay is labeled, not physical evidence.
No application command writes to Uno.
Port opening may reset Uno via DTR.
Flush is not a power-loss guarantee.
Partial line closed as error on session end.
Do not join bytes across reconnects.
Reset framer for each new session.
Exact keys, types, bounds and null flags.
Track sequence gaps / duplicates; handle wraps
Sequence event is not proof of a reset.
A valid frame can contain ZERO samples.
CSV is derived; preserve the run bundle.
Counts of valid frames, IMU samples and
sessions / events record open, close and disconnects.
Open failure is recorded; retry uses configured delay.
Sequence tracking starts fresh for each session.
No hardware reset cause or stale-input watchdog inferred.
health: CPU temperature + disk free bytes.
CPU temperature is not enclosure ambient.
Low disk stops run with failure status.
SIGINT / SIGTERM close normally; no motion watchdog.
SOURCE ONLY: logger.py; service is draft
Config / logger SHA256, mode, environment and counts.
Orderly close: fsync raw, raw SHA256, final status / counts.
Firmware correspondence stays unverified; fw is self-report.
Recover original sketch and capture actual serial before adapting hardware.
Confirm Pi model / OS / port / USB power, sensor boards and enabled pins.
10Hz is a draft target. No field rate, loss limit or calibration is validated.
Default null frames exercise transport; they are not physical sensor data.
Optional camera video + sidecar capture is separate; fitting is unknown.
No synchronized-video accuracy, voltage/GPS logging or cloud path exists here.
No motion commands, autonomy, E-stop or vehicle-control watchdog in draft.
Abrupt power-loss recovery and physical deployment remain untested.
ARCH-R2 | 2026-11-22 | Editable source + SVG/PNG | PDFs HELD | Scope and evidence: architecture-model.json / README.md
